scope: Fourteen-theme US societal, cultural, consumer, political, institutional, firm, infrastructure, and geopolitical atlas
interpretation: Six organizing tensions summarize recurring measurement problems; they are not pooled causal effects or additional themes.

tensions.name: Capacity versus control
tensions.test: Can the affected unit understand, contest, correct, and control the system or use a credible fallback?
tensions.evidence_boundary: Formal capacity, completion, acceptance, or operation is not user control or leverage.

tensions.name: Offer versus usability
tensions.test: Can the same unit reach and use the option under its money, time, health, transport, safety, status, and schedule constraints?
tensions.evidence_boundary: A nominal alternative is not practical choice until access, use, adequacy, and durability are observed.

tensions.name: Correction versus contestability
tensions.test: Who knew, could appeal, had help and documents, and could persist long enough to reach correction?
tensions.evidence_boundary: Success among appeals or approved claims is not a correction rate for all affected units; non-appeal is not acceptance.

tensions.name: Support versus burden transfer
tensions.test: Who performs the hidden work, absorbs delay, or carries residual risk when formal support is insufficient?
tensions.evidence_boundary: Help can protect one currency while transferring cost into unpaid time, stigma, money, coordination, or helper strain.

tensions.name: Recovery versus durability
tensions.test: Did receipt, repair, reactivation, credit, return, or operation remain adequate and protective over time?
tensions.evidence_boundary: An immediate or reported improvement is not durable recovery without recurrence, continuity, and later security checks.

tensions.name: Dependence versus exit
tensions.test: What alternative existed, what would leaving cost, and what did the unit protect or sacrifice by staying?
tensions.evidence_boundary: Continued use, non-use, closure, program exit, or firm exit is not automatically free choice or improved security.

source_note: The register is a synthesis control. It does not convert the 14 theme units, 97 event ledgers, or 385 trend records into one common denominator.
